h2. Description

*Tech View's white table should run edge to edge*, with no side gutter and no panel around it. On staging a grey strip shows on both sides.

For example,
* at 1440 px the table starts about 30 points in from the left edge and stops about 30 points before the right edge
* the same at 1536 px

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10045*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
#* A grey strip shows to the left and right of the white table.

*Actual Result:*
* The table has a grey side gutter on both sides.

*Expected Result:*
* The table runs edge to edge, as the test expects: *"Step 2: the table is white and runs from the left edge of the page to the right edge: the column header row, every group header and every row start right at the page's left edge, with no grey strip, margin or gap on either side, and there is no card, panel, rounded corner or shadow around the table. Side by side with the 1440 px design picture, the white table meets the browser edge on the left in the same way."*
